newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money locked in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money locked in tight range.

text.p: Manila overnight money was locked in a narrower range on Thursday at 10.31256 to 10.28125 percent since most banks have met their requirements for the week, traders said.
The market had 23 lenders and 13 borrowers. Market volume was lower at 9.965 billion from 19.229 billion pesos.
In the secondary market, there were more buyers of short-term bills in the market amid the continued high liquidity experienced by banks.
Banks have been shying away from term reverse repos which have a 20 percent tax.
"Banks are looking for outlets to invest," a dealer said.
Seven financial institutions polled by Reuters gave bid rates of 10.05 to 10.10 percent for three-month bills.
